{{Short description|Polish biologist}}

[[File:Andrzej Lesicki.jpg|thumb|upright=1.1|Andrzej Lesicki in 2016]]

'''Andrzej Lesicki''' (born 8 October 1950) is a Polish [[biologist]], [[Zoology|zoologist]], [[Malacology|malacologist]] and a professor at [[Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań|Adam Mickiewicz University, Poznań (AMU)]], in Poland. Between 2008 and 2016 he was Vice-President of AMU responsible for human resources and development and is now AMU's Rector for the term of office from 2016 until 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://amu.edu.pl/uniwersytet/wladze|title=Władze UAM|publisher=Adam Mickiewicz University, Poznań}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
He graduated from the [[Karol Marcinkowski High School]] in 1968, then studied zoology at AMU and graduated with honors in 1973. Following the completion of his studies he was employed by AMU where he pursued his academic career. He wrote his [[doctoral dissertation]] on “Hormonal regulation of phosphofructokinase and pyruvate kinase activity in hepatopancreas and abdominal muscle of ''Orconectes limosus'' Raf. Crayfish” and earned his Ph.D. in 1973. In 1994 he earned his [[post-doctoral degree]] on the basis of research accomplishments and his post-doctoral dissertation on “Phosphofructokinase and pyruvate kinase of some crustacean and insect tissues".<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.perspektywy.pl/portal/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=2893:prof-andrzej-lesicki-rektorem-uniwersytetu-im-adama-mickiewicza-w-poznaniu|title=Prof. Andrzej Lesicki rektorem Uniwersytetu im. Adama Mickiewicza w Poznaniu|work=Perspektywy}}</ref>

As an academic, he first worked in AMU's Department of Animal Physiology between 1973 and 2003 and then from 2003 to 2005 in the Department of Cytology and Histology. Since 2005 he has been working as a professor and head of the Department of the Biology of Cell in the Institute of Experimental Biology of AMU's Faculty of Biology.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://biologia.amu.edu.pl/page.php?id=wydzial-wladze&ip=kierownicy_zakladow|title=Kierownicy Zakładów, Pracowni, Jednostek}}</ref>

A founding member of the Association of Polish Malacologists (APM) in 1994, he was first the association's treasurer, then its Vice-President and then became APM's President.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.malakologia.org/stowarzyszenie_wladze.html|title=Władze Stowarzyszenia|website=Stowarzyszenie Malakologów Polskich}}</ref> He is editor-in-chief of Folia Malacologica, a research periodical published by APM and that of Biological Letters, a half-yearly, published by [[Poznań Society of Friends of Learning|Poznańskie Towarzystwo Przyjaciół Nauk]] and AMU's Faculty of Biology.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://foliamalacologica.com/en/editorial-board,67.html|title=Editorial Board|website=Folia Malacologica}}</ref> In the years 1998-2003 he was a member of the [[Polish Zoological Society]] and since 2010 he has been a member of the [[Freshwater Biological Association]].

He also conducted research abroad, at the [[University of Oxford]], [[United Kingdom|UK]] in 1984 as well as several times between 1997 and 2001 at the [[University of Bedfordshire|University of Luton]], [[United Kingdom|UK]] and at the [[University of Vechta|Hochschule Vechta]], [[Germany]].

He has performed important functions at AMU. Between 1996 and 2002 he was Vice-Dean and from 2002 until 2008 Dean of the Faculty of Biology.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://biologia.amu.edu.pl/page.php?id=promocja_historia_wydzialu&ip=dziekani|title=Dziekani Wydziału Biologii}}</ref> He served as AMU's Vice-President from 2008 to 2016. On 4 April 2016 he was elected AMU Rector for the term of office from 2016 to 2020.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://poznan.wyborcza.pl/poznan/1,36001,19863422,prof-andrzej-lesicki-nowym-rektorem-uam.html|title=Prof. Andrzej Lesicki nowym rektorem UAM|last=Mazur|first=Natalia|date=April 4, 2016|work=Gazeta Wyborcza}}</ref>

In 2014 he completed [[Master of Business Administration|MBA]] post-graduate studies offered jointly by AMU and the [[Poznań University of Economics and Business|Poznan University of Economics]].

== Awards and honors ==
* He has been distinguished by the [[Hipolit Cegielski Society]] with a silver medal "Labor omnia vincit" for the popularization of the idea of organic work and with a statuette "Honorary Hipolit".<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.thc.org.pl/aktualnosci/7|title=XIX Walne Zebranie THC. Wyróżnienia dla Liderów Pracy Organicznej|date=June 27, 2017|publisher=Towarzystwo im. Hipolita Cegielskiego}}</ref>
* He has been awarded by the [[Ministry of Higher Education (Poland)|Ministry of Higher Education]] for his post-doctoral dissertation and received several awards at AMU.
* Asteroid [[82937 Lesicki]], discovered by [[Petr Pravec]] and [[Peter Kušnirák]] at [[Ondřejov Observatory]] in 2001, was named in his honor.<ref name="jpldata" /><ref name="MPC-object" /> The official {{MoMP|82937|naming citation}} was published by the [[Minor Planet Center]] on 6 April 2019 ({{small|[[Minor Planet Circulars|M.P.C.]] 112432}}).<ref name="MPC-Circulars-Archive" />
